query: WITH company_scope AS (SELECT "company", sum("complaint_count") AS "complaint_count", sum("timely_response_count") AS "timely_response_count", sum("timely_response_known_count") AS "timely_response_known_count" FROM "company_month_metrics" GROUP BY "company"), volume_cohort AS (SELECT *, "timely_response_count"::DOUBLE / nullif("timely_response_known_count", 0) AS "timely_response_rate" FROM company_scope ORDER BY "complaint_count" DESC, "company" ASC LIMIT 10) SELECT "company", "complaint_count", "timely_response_count", "timely_response_known_count", "timely_response_rate" FROM volume_cohort ORDER BY "timely_response_rate" ASC NULLS LAST, "company" ASC LIMIT 1
